mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{code})
SELECT FROM sys_permission ORDER BY permission_code ASC

SELECT permission.permission_code FROM sys_permission permission JOIN sys_user user_account ON user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE permission.status = 'ENABLED' AND permission.client_type IN ('BOTH', #{client}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.status = 'ENABLED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.status = 'ENABLED' AND role_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND role_permission.effect = 'DENY' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_permission user_permission WHERE user_permission.user_id = #{userId} AND user_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND user_permission.effect = 'DENY' ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.status = 'ENABLED' AND role_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND role_permission.effect = 'ALLOW' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_permission user_permission WHERE user_permission.user_id = #{userId} AND user_permission.permission_id = permission.id AND user_permission.effect = 'ALLOW' ) ) ORDER BY permission.permission_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET permission_name = #{name}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_permission SET permission_code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id}
